claims.text: Applying PSSOS can improve the accuracy of transition-temperature determination relative to existing experimental and computational methods.
Applying PSSOS can improve the accuracy of fusion-enthalpy determination relative to existing experimental and computational methods.
Applying PSSOS can improve the accuracy of fusion-entropy determination relative to existing experimental and computational methods.
Applying PSSOS can improve the accuracy of volume-change determination at the transition relative to existing experimental and computational methods.
Applying PSSOS can improve the accuracy of dense-fluid heat-capacity determination relative to existing experimental and computational methods.
PSSOS can represent candidate crystal structures using preselected ordered structures in FCC and BCC lattices.
Crystal structure affects the thermodynamic properties of high-entropy materials.
PSSOS takes interactions between atoms into account.
Representing crystal structure and atomic interactions through PSSOS produces accurate calculations of the targeted transition and dense-fluid thermodynamic properties.
PSSOS is applicable at temperatures above the material's melting point.
The proposed application covers multicomponent high-entropy materials in either solid or liquid states.
PSSOS accuracy may depend on material composition and thermodynamic conditions.
